(2) The hand sets down the keychain and picks up a blue JoJo's Bizarre Adventure wafer pack, displaying the character art of Jotaro and Polnareff. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the metallic texture of the foil packaging. (3) The person uses both hands to tear open the blue foil pack from the top. They pull out a white plastic tray containing a rectangular wafer cookie and a collectible card sealed in a small plastic sleeve. (4) The hand holds up the newly revealed card, which shows the character Alessi from the JoJo series against a purple striped background. The person turns the card around to show the back, which contains character stats and Japanese text. (5) The hand reaches for a second yellow foil pack featuring the character DIO. They proceed to tear this pack open as well, revealing another wafer and a card. This card features DIO in a dynamic pose. (6) Both cards are placed side-by-side on the anime desk mat, which depicts a character with long purple hair. The person gestures towards the cards, showing the successful pulls from the unboxing session.
